gcm.purpose: Eight custom direct-mail prospect presentations, contact-safe source proof and Radar engagement tracking.
changeNotes: Eight independent and unlisted print-advertiser prospect presentations, plus exact-name D1 Radar engagement mapping; no Radar prospect rows are created automatically.

Prepare reviewed Southeast Safes September–October Facebook/Instagram history import: 25 content records, 43 platform placements, with existing scheduled BOGO outcomes excluded; nothing writes before operator confirmation.
Signed publisher attribution and revision history, duplicate-safe additional placements linked to exact clients and optional existing scheduled sources.
Add Social Publishing Library (read-only) under Media; preserve schedules/outcomes, prepare empty client publishing/placement/assets D1 tables.
Close only first-day promotion launch milestones supported by complete D1 social publication proof; preserve full sale window and takedown.
Exclude closed/archived Radar records from Today's prospect engagement count; verify with actual SQLite query while preserving historical activity.
Deploys approved daily Cloudflare Cron for 30-day private R2 cleanup, preserving held/client/shared assets with metadata audit.
Retests 30-day R2 cleanup model with corrected mocked batch LIMIT/recheck argument distinction.
Tests safe private R2 cleanup eligibility, reopened/client/shared/held protections, idempotence and failure handling, prior to scheduled activation.
Reverify 30-day evidence retention transition regression after distinguishing archive and restoration SQL in mock.
Test 30-day Radar advertisement-evidence retention metadata, held/owned asset exclusions, and reopening cancellation before enabling physical cleanup.
Adds atomic Radar business/market duplicate guard and browser Save lock, with no schema or CRM contract change.
Fix Safari image decoding in Advertising Evidence: fallback after createImageBitmap Blob rejection and verify no write until both images compress.
Rerun full production tests after Safari-compatible image compression and Prospects 3.9.1 regression alignment.
Regression-locks Radar advertising evidence UI script syntax and secure upload controls.
Adds private source-evidence upload/read authentication and idempotency regression to the full Worker deployment gate.
Adds a dedicated Radar archive separate from Nurture / Hold.
Keeps existing contact, outreach and intelligence evidence without automatic bulk-marketing enrollment.
Regression-locks archive and restore actions using an in-memory D1 stand-in; no production record writes.
Separates unidentified Schedule Authority radio notes from named commercials and creative-aging metrics.
Renders sent-traffic-based media operating status alongside creative age as-of selected month; no broadcast proof claimed.
Adds September SES calendar presentation regression tests without changing production data.
